subject.title: fix(feishu): retry once on token-invalid errors 99991663/99991664 with cache invalidation (fixes #97287)

question: Should this PR be the canonical Feishu invalid-token recovery branch, and is its all-registered-cache invalidation scope acceptable?
rationale: Multiple open PRs implement the same Feishu 99991663/99991664 recovery with different cache-invalidation shapes, and automation cannot choose the owner-boundary tradeoff or accept stale current-head proof.

options.title: Repair proof and keep this branch
options.body: Require current-head redacted Feishu proof, then use this branch if maintainers accept clearing the registered SDK and CardKit token caches on token-invalid responses.

options.title: Choose a narrower sibling
options.body: Select a sibling PR if maintainers prefer account-scoped invalidation or a smaller diff, then close this branch after preserving useful proof context.

options.title: Pause the cluster
options.body: Hold all candidate PRs if Feishu owners want a different cache ownership design before invalid-token retry lands.

recommendation.title: Repair proof and keep this branch
recommendation.body: Require current-head redacted Feishu proof, then use this branch if maintainers accept clearing the registered SDK and CardKit token caches on token-invalid responses.

likelyOwner.reason: sliverp is the listed Feishu routing owner and merged the adjacent Feishu retry helper that this PR extends.
